title: Line sketch: Vibrant Swirling Fluid Dance
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: This abstract artwork explodes with dynamic swirling patterns, spirals, and organic waves flowing across the entire frame. Bold curves and circular motifs create a sense of continuous movement and energy. Fluid composition techniques produce layered, marbled effects with visible color bleeding and soft edges (derived from painting #147).
